title: TV-size text in the demo
why: His answer Q21 (10-18): TV-size text is on by default in the demo. The party runs on two TVs 6 to 10 feet away. The demo sandbox starts at HUD size 150 percent; his own size comes back on leaving.
now: The demo starts with bigger text for the TVs.
